name: GPON ONU
subtitle: Industrial - Gateway
description: A compact single-port GPON ONU on RTL9601D chipset designed to terminate fiber-optic GPON connections and deliver Gigabit Ethernet connectivity for FTTH deployments in residential, retail, and multi-dwelling unit rollouts.

physical.value: 90 x 27 x 80 mm (W x H x D)

use_cases.title: Residential FTTH Last-Mile Termination
use_cases.desc: Delivering high-speed fiber broadband connectivity to residential homes and apartments through Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) networks, enabling reliable internet access, IPTV, VoIP services, and seamless connectivity for smart home devices and everyday digital applications.

use_cases.title: Small Office / Retail Fiber Connectivity
use_cases.desc: Ideal for providing reliable, high-speed fiber internet connectivity to small offices, retail stores, and branch locations, enabling seamless POS transactions, cloud application access, VoIP communication, and secure data transmission for uninterrupted business operations.

use_cases.title: MDU (Multi-Dwelling Unit) Bulk Rollouts
use_cases.desc: Deploying high-speed fiber broadband connectivity across apartments, residential complexes, and multi-tenant buildings, enabling scalable network installations, centralized management, and reliable internet, IPTV, and VoIP services for multiple households through a shared fiber infrastructure.
